_note: Canonical Btab brand colors (single source of truth). `green` is wired as the `btab-green` token in each dashboard's tailwind.config.ts and is the fixed fill of the 'B' in brand/BtabLogo.tsx. `navy` is the favicon tile background (brand/icon.svg). `tabGray` is the wordmark 'tab' colour on light surfaces — note the in-app <BtabLogo> renders 'tab' with currentColor so it adapts to its container, this value is the reference for static/marketing use.
